chunks: My father (peace be upon him) from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Sa'dabadi from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Umar ibn Shimr from Jabir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah, the Majestic in Glory, said: 'O son of Adam! Remember Me for an hour after the morning prayer and for an hour after the afternoon prayer, and I will suffice you against that which preoccupies you.'

key_terms.أَكْفِكَ: I will suffice you / protect you from
key_terms.مَا أَهَمَّكَ: That which preoccupies you / your important affairs

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for remembering Allah after morning and afternoon prayers?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith highlights the specific spiritual discipline of *Taaqibat al-Salat* (post-prayer supplications), emphasizing the morning and afternoon sessions as times of divine sufficiency (*Kifayah*). This practice is rooted in the Shia tradition of maintaining a continuous spiritual connection with Allah immediately after the obligatory prayers to secure relief from worldly anxieties and important affairs.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  narrates  that  the  Holy Prophet  (s.a.w.s.)  said  that  Allah,  the  Might  and  Sublime said,  “O  children  of  Adam!  Remember  Me  after  Morning Prayer for an hour and after Asr prayers for an hour so that I fulfill your important wishes.”
